remarks: Wow! Beautifully updated light and bright one bedroom corner unit ranch style with all the bells & whistles! Newer kitchen with white cabinets, water filtration system, gas cooking, dishwasher AND Washer/Dryer in unit. New Bath, hardwood floors throughout, crown molding, recessed lighting & ceiling fans. Reserved parking accessed from rear unit entrance and plenty of guest parking as well. Additional storage in basement. So convenient to vibrant downtown Stamford, I95, Metro North and all the wonderful restaurants Stamford has to offer! Don't miss this one! Just move in and unpack!
